Workspace changes

What file and repository actions are claimed?

Commands and checks

How can commands and tests run?

Current docs distinguish user-invoked commands and tests from configured automatic tests after edits.

Tool · Command Execution

Current in-chat command documentation describes `/run` as executing a shell command with an option to add its output to chat, and `/git` as executing a git command without adding output to chat.

Model and mode

Which reasoning and editing path applies?
